intro: In Cathedral Square, Randis waits for a chance to see the world beyond Stormwind. During Children's Week, he eagerly joins willing adventurers across Alliance lands.

p: Randis lives in the orphanage near Stormwind's Cathedral of Light, one of many children left without family by the realm's conflicts. When Children's Week comes each year, Orphan Matron Nightingale gives sympathetic heroes a whistle and entrusts them with his care. Curious and full of questions, Randis dreams of adventure, asks riddles, and declares that he wants to be king of Stormwind when he grows up.

For Randis, who spends most days in Cathedral Square, leaving the capital is a grand adventure. He remarks that places like Ironforge smell odd, and his wonder shows what Alliance heroes fight to protect.
